about_hero.for_djs_who_feel: for Those who feel the music

about_one.mission_paragraph:
Putting together a set that tells a story is no trivial task.
Tracks that fit - tonally, emotionally, energetically - are buried
under platforms that rank by popularity rather than
sonic character
about_one.mission_paragraph_answer:
We're building the tool we always needed: one that listens
to a reference track the way a DJ does and finds what belongs beside it
about_one.headline_alternative_route:
Music Discovery That Goes Deeper
Than Tags And Trends
about_one.tech_paragraph:
PYXIS-1 reads the full sonic character of a song
tempo shifts, harmonic tension, dynamic range, spectral energy
and finds music that matches at the structural level
about_one.result_paragraph:
The result: recommendations based on
how music actually sounds, not how it's labeled.

about_two.preamble_one:
We care about one thing: that you find the right track for the right
moment - the one that galvanizes your audience and sets you apart
about_two.preamble_two:
We're here to make that process faster, more intuitive,
and grounded in what matters most: the music
about_two.vision_intro:
A world where every track gets discovered on its own terms
Not by chart position, not by marketing budget, not by release date
about_two.vision_span:
Resomix maps the full sonic DNA of a song's structure and finds its perfect match, regardless of who released it or when.
That's what music discovery should be
about_two.diff_intro: Our discovery engine uses a computational algorithm that identifies musical patterns at the granular level
about_two.diff_span: Operating entirely outside the streaming ecosystem's popularity bias
about_two.card_analysis_desc: Pure signal processing. No artificial curation, no black-box AI - just deterministic audio analysis across 70+ sonic dimensions
about_two.card_craft_desc: PYXIS-1 maps a track's subtlety, dynamics, flow, rhythm, texture, and energy. Like a DJ reading the room, it responds to what the music actually communicates
about_two.card_path_desc: Within seconds, a precisely matched selection of tracks that share your reference's sonic character - regardless of genre, release date, or popularity

about_three.intro: Every catalog has a hidden layer - tracks that never made it to charts, albums that fell through algorithmic cracks, artists who create brilliant work outside the spotlight. Resomix was built to find them
about_three.card_speed_desc: You still make the call. We help you get there faster - surfacing tracks that standard search and streaming algorithms miss
about_three.card_open_desc: When discovery is based on sonic character alone, every artist competes on equal terms - regardless of label size, marketing budget, or chart history
about_three.card_quality_desc: Transparent data, clear licensing, and an open approach to partnerships. Built for labels, platforms, and developers to collaborate with
about_three.card_crate_desc: Fewer results, higher relevance. You control how many recommendations you see every time

about_four.audience_djs_desc: — who need the right tracks for the right moment in their set
about_four.audience_producers_desc: — seeking sonic references for sound design, texture, and creative direction
about_four.audience_curators_desc: — who build playlists around sonic cohesion, not genre labels
about_four.audience_music_enthusiasts_desc: — who dig deeper than algorithms will take them
about_four.run_by:
Resomix is run by DJs, engineers,
and music professionals
about_four.mission:
We want to build a better way
to discover and enjoy music across genres
